headline: Insurance Broker Arachas Reports 25% Profit Surge Following Acquisition Drive
summary: Irish insurance broker Arachas achieved a 25% increase in annual profits, driven by an aggressive company acquisition strategy. The company distributed €60 million in dividends to shareholders.
why: Arachas is one of Ireland's largest commercial insurance brokerages.

impacts.name: Arachas
impacts.why: Strong earnings expansion enabled a €60 million dividend payout to capital holders.
